# uptimekuma_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists the API keys. The secrets themselves are never returned — Uptime Kuma only stores hashes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_api_keys" "all" {}

output "expired_api_keys" {
  value = [for key in data.uptimekuma_api_keys.all.api_keys : key.name if key.status == "expired"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) The API keys, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the key is enabled.
- `expires` (String) Expiry timestamp, if set.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the key.
- `name` (String) Name of the key.
- `status` (String) `active`, `inactive` or `expired`.
